simulation.description: 徒歩で隊列戦と白兵戦を担う、比較的重装備の職業的戦闘員。特定の服装や武具形式はスキルが14世紀ヨーロッパの史料から確定する。

identity.silhouette: Compact, broad-shouldered adult foot soldier in a pointed visored bascinet, mail aventail and fitted short surcoat over layered armor; articulated plate at forearms, knees and shins gives a segmented lower-body silhouette without a bulky full plate cuirass.
identity.garments: Quilted arming doublet and padded chausses beneath a close-fitting knee-to-mid-thigh wool surcoat/jupon, muted madder red with a narrow deep-blue vertical accent; simple hems, no theatrical tabard or modern tailoring.
identity.armor: Steel visored bascinet with visible leather edging and mail aventail; dark iron mail shirt at shoulders and torso; hourglass gauntlets; small plate rerebraces and vambraces; poleyns and greaves over padded legs; plain functional finish with natural scuffs.
identity.weapons: One straight single-handed arming sword, approximately body-length, drawn and held in the anatomical right hand in combat-ready poses; the empty dark leather scabbard remains attached at the anatomical left hip. Plain cruciform guard, dark leather grip, simple wheel pommel; no second weapon or shield.
identity.handedness: Anatomical right hand is the dominant sword hand and holds the drawn blade; the empty scabbard remains on the anatomical left hip. Keep belt buckle, scabbard and sword side assignments fixed and never mirror them between directions.
identity.palette: Cool gray steel, charcoal-black mail, muted madder red wool, deep blue accent cloth, dark brown leather and scabbard, small warm brass fittings, natural light skin only where the face is visible.
invariants: Exactly one adult human men-at-arms identity in every frame.
Visored bascinet and mail aventail remain present and consistent.
Sword remains on the anatomical left hip with the dominant right hand.
No shield, bow, spear, horse, heraldic crest, extra weapon, or modern item.
Camera, scale, lighting direction, foot anchor and transparent alpha remain fixed.

renderStyle.prompt: full-color photorealistic historical character cutout; physically plausible human anatomy; natural skin texture; visible cloth weave, worn leather grain, wood grain, and realistic metal reflections; neutral color-accurate studio lighting; production-quality game character photography

variant 2 equipment check; hands relax back to the starting guard and the surcoat settles

variant 3 rested guard; weight returns toward center with no step and no change to equipment sides
